items.headline: Hormuz tanker traffic rebounds but stays subdued
items.summary: Reuters-tracked data cited by Trading Economics show oil transiting the Strait of Hormuz climbing to a wartime high, yet Kpler reported tanker crossings remaining below the 10-day average, a key freight-risk signal for crude desks.

items.headline: EMIR reconciliation deadline set for late September
items.summary: Per Regnology, the EMIR data-reconciliation start date has been fixed at 28 September 2026 for previously open fields, while the underlying-index-name reconciliation requirement has been dropped, easing one compliance burden for commodity derivatives reporters.

items.headline: Trade-finance DLT platforms attempt a second wave
items.summary: Espeo Software notes that first-generation blockchain trade-finance networks such as TradeLens, we.trade, Marco Polo and Contour have wound down, even though pilots had shown letter-of-credit processing cut from days to hours, prompting a more focused 'second wave' of tools.

items.headline: New CTRM software market sizing report published
items.summary: Commodity Technology Advisory released its 2026 CTRM Software Market Sizing Report, examining the size, growth outlook and changing structure of the global commodity trading and risk management software market.
